parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing positives: no criminalisation, no documented border/document friction (self-ID, foreign markers accepted, silence in a well-documented state), no bathroom/facility ban, no police targeting of trans people, and a functioning legal order (conversion practices prosecuted as torture, marriage equality, official pride participation, penalties for anti-LGBT public speech). Negatives: a documented, unremedied custody regime placing trans women — including a foreign national — in male pavilions with sexual violence, forced head-shaving and a 2026 death in custody; that is a severe conditional exposure (only bites on detention) but it is state-imposed with no working remedy. Society is conservative, 2011 discrimination findings are dated, and the armed-conflict-driven rise in anti-LGBT violence is unquantified, so it cannot be weighed as a campaign. Strong formal climate signals do not offset the documented carceral exposure; hence just below the reduced-risk tier.
